factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang isang kolonya ng bubuyog ay may iisang reyna na siyang ina ng halos lahat ng pukyutan sa pugad
hook.en: a bee colony has a single queen who is the mother of almost every bee in the hive

body.tl: Kaya niyang mangitlog ng hanggang 2,000 itlog sa isang araw — mas mabigat pa sa kabuuang timbang niya! Ang ibang bubuyog ay mga manggagawang nag-iipon ng nektar at gumagawa ng pulot.
body.en: She can lay up to 2,000 eggs a day — more than her own body weight! The other bees are workers that gather nectar and make honey.

factoids.source: Honeybee queen lays ~1,500–2,000 eggs/day; workers forage and make honey.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: kaya ng isang langgam na buhatin ang bagay na hanggang 50 beses na mas mabigat kaysa sa sarili nitong timbang
hook.en: an ant can lift things up to 50 times heavier than its own body weight

body.tl: Kung kasinglakas tayo ng langgam, kaya nating mag-angat ng kotse! Namumuhay rin sila sa malalaking kolonyang may libu-libong magkakasama na may iba't ibang tungkulin.
body.en: If we were as strong as an ant, we could lift a car! Ants live in huge colonies of thousands, each with its own job.

factoids.source: Ants carry ~10–50× body weight; eusocial colonies with division of labor.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang mga paruparo ay 'nakakatikim' gamit ang kanilang mga paa
hook.en: butterflies 'taste' with their feet

body.tl: May mga panlasa silang sensor sa paa para malaman kung tamang halaman ang dadapuan at pag-iitlugan. Bago naging paruparo, sila ay higad muna na dumaan sa metamorphosis.
body.en: They have taste sensors on their feet to check if a plant is right for landing and laying eggs. Before becoming butterflies, they were caterpillars that went through metamorphosis.

factoids.source: Butterflies have chemoreceptors (taste) on their tarsi; complete metamorphosis.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang sapot ng gagamba ay mas matibay pa kaysa sa bakal kung pagkukumparahin sa parehong bigat
hook.en: spider silk is stronger than steel of the same weight

body.tl: Likha ito ng protinang nanggagaling sa katawan ng gagamba. Karamihan ng gagamba ay may walong paa at walong mata, at hindi sila insekto kundi arachnid.
body.en: It is made from a protein produced in the spider's body. Most spiders have eight legs and eight eyes, and are not insects but arachnids.

factoids.source: Spider dragline silk has higher tensile strength than steel by weight; spiders are arachnids (8 legs).

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang mga babaeng lamok lamang ang kumakagat at sumisipsip ng dugo
hook.en: only female mosquitoes bite and suck blood

body.tl: Kailangan nila ng protina mula sa dugo para makapangitlog; ang mga lalaking lamok ay umiinom lang ng nektar. Isa ang lamok sa pinakadelikadong hayop dahil nagdadala ito ng sakit tulad ng dengue.
body.en: They need protein from blood to lay eggs; male mosquitoes only drink nectar. The mosquito is one of the deadliest animals because it spreads diseases like dengue.

factoids.source: Only female mosquitoes blood-feed (egg protein); mosquitoes are major disease vectors.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: kaya ng tutubi na lumipad pasulong, paatras, at tumigil sa ere tulad ng helicopter
hook.en: a dragonfly can fly forward, backward, and hover in the air like a helicopter

body.tl: Ang malalaki nilang mata ay may halos 30,000 na maliliit na lente, kaya halos 360 degrees ang nakikita nila sa paligid. Magaling silang manghuli ng lamok sa ere.
body.en: Their huge eyes have nearly 30,000 tiny lenses, giving them almost 360-degree vision. They are expert hunters of mosquitoes in mid-air.

factoids.source: Dragonflies hover and fly backward; compound eyes ~28,000–30,000 ommatidia; near-360° vision.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang bawat mata ng tarsier ay halos kasinlaki ng kanyang utak
hook.en: each of a tarsier's eyes is almost as big as its brain

body.tl: Hindi nila maigalaw ang kanilang mga mata, kaya iniikot nila ang ulo nang halos 180 degrees para tumingin sa likod. Matatagpuan ang tarsier sa Bohol at iba pang bahagi ng Pilipinas.
body.en: They cannot move their eyes, so they rotate their heads almost 180 degrees to look behind. Tarsiers are found in Bohol and other parts of the Philippines.

factoids.source: Tarsier eyeball ≈ size of its brain; fixed eyes, ~180° head rotation; endemic to PH (Bohol).

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang Philippine Eagle ay isa sa pinakamalaki at pinakamakapangyarihang agila sa buong mundo
hook.en: the Philippine Eagle is one of the largest and most powerful eagles in the world

body.tl: Umaabot ang pakpak nito sa mahigit dalawang metro kapag nakabuka. Ito ang pambansang ibon ng Pilipinas at nanganganib nang maubos, kaya mahigpit itong pinoprotektahan.
body.en: Its wingspan reaches more than two meters when spread. It is the national bird of the Philippines and is critically endangered, so it is strictly protected.

factoids.source: Philippine Eagle: among largest eagles, wingspan up to ~2 m; national bird; critically endangered.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang paniki o kabag ang tanging mammal na talagang nakakalipad
hook.en: the bat is the only mammal that can truly fly

body.tl: Gumagamit ang ilang paniki ng 'echolocation' — nagpapadala sila ng tunog at pinapakinggan ang alingawngaw nito para makahanap ng pagkain sa dilim. Marami sa kanila ay kumakain ng prutas at insekto.
body.en: Some bats use echolocation — they send out sound and listen to its echo to find food in the dark. Many of them eat fruit and insects.

factoids.source: Bats are the only mammals capable of true (powered) flight; many use echolocation.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang palaka ay nakakahinga rin sa pamamagitan ng kanilang balat
hook.en: a frog can also breathe through its skin

body.tl: Kailangang manatiling mamasa-masa ang kanilang balat para makahinga nang maayos, kaya madalas silang nasa malapit sa tubig. Dumadaan sila sa metamorphosis mula tadpole hanggang maging palaka.
body.en: Their skin must stay moist to breathe properly, so they usually stay near water. They go through metamorphosis from tadpole to frog.

factoids.source: Frogs perform cutaneous respiration (need moist skin); metamorphosis tadpole→frog.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang munting suso o kuhol ay maaaring magkaroon ng libu-libong maliliit na ngipin sa kanilang dila
hook.en: a tiny snail can have thousands of microscopic teeth on its tongue

body.tl: Ginagamit nila ang dilang tinatawag na 'radula' para magkayod ng pagkain. Nag-iiwan din sila ng makintab na uhog kapag gumagapang para hindi masaktan sa magaspang na ibabaw.
body.en: They use a tongue called a 'radula' to scrape food. They also leave a shiny mucus trail when crawling so they aren't hurt on rough surfaces.

factoids.source: Snails have a radula bearing thousands of tiny teeth; secrete mucus to move.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang mga bulate sa lupa ay tumutulong para maging mas masustansya ang lupa para sa mga halaman
hook.en: earthworms help make soil more fertile for plants

body.tl: Habang humuhukay sila, naglalagay sila ng hangin sa lupa at pinapapino ang mga nabubulok na dahon. Wala silang baga — humihinga sila sa pamamagitan ng kanilang basang balat.
body.en: As they burrow, they put air into the soil and break down rotting leaves. They have no lungs — they breathe through their moist skin.

factoids.source: Earthworms aerate soil and recycle organic matter; respire through moist skin.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: kaya ng tuko na gumapang nang patiwarik sa kisame nang hindi nahuhulog
hook.en: a gecko can crawl upside-down on the ceiling without falling

body.tl: May milyun-milyong napakaliliit na buhok sa kanilang mga paa na kumakapit nang husto kahit sa makinis na salamin. Tinawag silang 'tuko' dahil sa tunog ng kanilang tawag.
body.en: Their feet have millions of microscopic hairs that grip even smooth glass. They are called 'tuko' because of the sound of their call.

factoids.source: Gecko toes use setae (van der Waals adhesion) to climb; tokay named onomatopoeically.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang ilang pagong ay maaaring mabuhay nang mahigit 100 taon
hook.en: some turtles can live for more than 100 years

body.tl: Umiral na ang lahi ng pagong kasabay ng mga dinosaur, mahigit 200 milyong taon na ang nakalilipas. Dala-dala nila kahit saan ang kanilang 'bahay' — ang matigas nilang talukab.
body.en: Turtles have existed alongside the dinosaurs, more than 200 million years ago. They carry their 'house' everywhere — their hard shell.

factoids.source: Many turtles/tortoises live 100+ years; turtles arose ~220 Mya (alongside early dinosaurs).

factoids.subject: earth-science

hook.tl: ang tubig na iniinom natin ngayon ay maaaring kasing-edad na ng mga dinosaur
hook.en: the water we drink today may be as old as the dinosaurs

body.tl: Hindi nauubos ang tubig sa mundo — paulit-ulit lang itong umiikot: sumisingaw mula sa dagat, nagiging ulap, bumabagsak bilang ulan, at dumadaloy pabalik sa dagat. Ito ang tinatawag na water cycle.
body.en: Earth's water is never used up — it just keeps cycling: it evaporates from the sea, becomes clouds, falls as rain, and flows back to the sea. This is the water cycle.

factoids.source: Water cycle is closed; molecules recycle over geological time.

factoids.subject: earth-science

hook.tl: ang buwan ay hindi talaga nagbabago ng hugis — ang bahagi nitong naliliwanagan ng araw lang ang nagbabago
hook.en: the moon does not really change shape — only the part lit by the sun changes

body.tl: Habang umiikot ang buwan sa Earth, iba't ibang bahagi nito ang tinatamaan ng sikat ng araw, kaya tila nagbabago ang hugis: bilog, kalahati, o pahabang crescent. Mga 29 na araw ang isang buong ikot.
body.en: As the moon orbits Earth, different parts catch the sun's light, so its shape seems to change: full, half, or a thin crescent. One full cycle takes about 29 days.

factoids.source: Lunar phases = changing sunlit fraction as Moon orbits; synodic month ~29.5 days.

factoids.subject: earth-science

hook.tl: napakalaki ng araw kaya halos 1.3 milyong Earth ang kasya sa loob nito
hook.en: the sun is so big that about 1.3 million Earths could fit inside it

body.tl: Ang araw ay isang malaking bola ng nag-aalab na gas at ito ang sentro ng ating solar system. Ang walong planeta, kasama ang Earth, ay umiikot sa paligid nito.
body.en: The sun is a giant ball of glowing gas and the center of our solar system. The eight planets, including Earth, orbit around it.

factoids.source: ~1.3 million Earths fit within the Sun's volume; 8 planets orbit the Sun.

factoids.subject: earth-science

hook.tl: ang Pilipinas ay may mahigit 20 aktibong bulkan dahil nasa 'Pacific Ring of Fire' ito
hook.en: the Philippines has more than 20 active volcanoes because it sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire

body.tl: Pumuputok ang bulkan kapag ang mainit na magma mula sa ilalim ng lupa ay umaakyat at lumalabas bilang lava. Ang Bulkang Mayon ay sikat sa halos perpektong hugis-kono nito.
body.en: A volcano erupts when hot magma from deep underground rises and comes out as lava. Mayon Volcano is famous for its near-perfect cone shape.

factoids.source: PH has ~24 active volcanoes on the Ring of Fire; Mayon noted for symmetrical cone.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: tinatawag na 'tree of life' ang puno ng niyog dahil halos lahat ng bahagi nito ay may pakinabang
hook.en: the coconut is called the 'tree of life' because nearly every part of it is useful

body.tl: Mula sa prutas, tubig, langis, hanggang sa mga dahon at kahoy — lahat ay magagamit. Ang sariwang buko juice ay napakalinis kaya nagamit na ito noon sa emergency bilang pampalit na 'IV fluid'.
body.en: From its fruit, water, and oil to its leaves and wood — all of it can be used. Fresh coconut water is so clean it was once used in emergencies as a substitute IV fluid.

factoids.source: Coconut palm dubbed 'tree of life' in PH; coconut water used as emergency IV in documented wartime cases.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang kawayan ang isa sa pinakamabilis tumubong halaman sa buong mundo
hook.en: bamboo is one of the fastest-growing plants in the world

body.tl: May ilang uri nito na tumataas nang halos 90 sentimetro sa loob lamang ng isang araw! Bagama't parang puno, ang kawayan ay isang uri talaga ng damo o 'grass'.
body.en: Some species can grow nearly 90 centimeters in just one day! Although it looks like a tree, bamboo is actually a kind of grass.

factoids.source: Bamboo is the fastest-growing plant; record growth up to ~90 cm/day; bamboo is a grass (Poaceae).

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang sampaguita ang pambansang bulaklak ng Pilipinas
hook.en: the sampaguita is the national flower of the Philippines

body.tl: Kahit maliit at puti lang ito, sikat ito sa napakabango nitong amoy lalo na kapag gabi. Madalas itong ginagawang kuwintas na inaalay sa mga simbahan at panauhin.
body.en: Though small and white, it is famous for its strong fragrance, especially at night. It is often strung into garlands offered in churches and to guests.

factoids.source: Sampaguita (Jasminum sambac) is the PH national flower; fragrant, made into garlands.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang narra ang pambansang puno ng Pilipinas
hook.en: the narra is the national tree of the Philippines

body.tl: Matibay at maganda ang kahoy nito kaya ginagamit ito sa muwebles. Kapag namumulaklak, nababalot ng dilaw na bulaklak ang buong puno. Sagisag ito ng tibay ng mga Pilipino.
body.en: Its wood is strong and beautiful, so it is used for furniture. When it blooms, the whole tree is covered in yellow flowers. It is a symbol of Filipino strength.

factoids.source: Narra (Pterocarpus indicus) is the PH national tree; prized hardwood; yellow flowers.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang kabute ay hindi halaman kundi isang uri ng 'fungi'
hook.en: a mushroom is not a plant but a kind of fungus

body.tl: Hindi sila gumagawa ng sariling pagkain gaya ng halaman — kumukuha sila ng sustansya mula sa mga nabubulok na bagay. May mga kabuteng nakakain, ngunit may mga nakakalason din, kaya mag-ingat.
body.en: They do not make their own food like plants — they take nutrients from decaying matter. Some mushrooms are edible, but others are poisonous, so be careful.

factoids.source: Mushrooms are fungi (own kingdom), not plants; many are decomposers; some species toxic.

factoids.subject: biology

hook.tl: ang dugo ng alimango at iba pang crustacean ay asul, hindi pula
hook.en: the blood of crabs and other crustaceans is blue, not red

body.tl: Ito ay dahil gumagamit sila ng 'hemocyanin' na may tanso (copper) para magdala ng oxygen — kabaligtaran ng 'hemoglobin' na may bakal (iron) na siyang nagpapapula sa dugo natin.
body.en: This is because they use 'hemocyanin,' which contains copper to carry oxygen — unlike 'hemoglobin,' which contains iron and makes our blood red.

factoids.source: Crustacean blood uses copper-based hemocyanin (blue); vertebrate blood uses iron-based hemoglobin (red).
